svg.title: Thrombocytopenia decision chart: grade the count, then sort by mechanism; marrow underproduction, immune thrombocytopenia, the schistocyte disorders (TTP by low ADAMTS-13, HUS after diarrhea with kidney injury, DIC with deranged clotting tests), heparin-induced thrombocytopenia, and pooled or spurious counts; each column gives clues, numbered investigations and management, with platelet transfusion forbidden where it fuels clotting
